files.doc: /** 📜️ The plan and transaction name checks of the taxonomy plan apply. */

phases.name: bindTransactionNames
phases.doc: Verifies the plan against the options and binds the canonical transaction, attempt, lease and preparation names.

phases.name: checkPlanAuthority
phases.doc: Captures the plan bytes, checks the plan and cancellation file stay outside the transaction and reads the transaction ancestors.

files.doc: /** 🔎️ The existing attempt discovery and validation of the taxonomy plan apply. */

phases.name: discoverTransactionAttempts
phases.doc: Reads the existing and unpublished attempt directories of the plan transaction.

phases.name: defineAttemptValidators
phases.doc: Validates the unpublished and terminal attempts and closes the terminal ones.

files.doc: /** 🎯️ The attempt selection and lease handling of the taxonomy plan apply. */

phases.name: selectAttempt
phases.doc: Selects the resumed attempt or allocates the next attempt ordinal and binds its journal paths.

phases.name: defineLeaseAndPreChecks
phases.doc: Defines the lease acquisition and release and checks the symlink targets, baseline commit and cancellation.

files.doc: /** 🛫️ The preflight reference basis and the resume snapshot lock of the taxonomy plan apply. */

phases.name: capturePreflight
phases.doc: Captures the preflight reference basis and verifies the pre-state of every planned operation.

phases.name: lockResumeSnapshot
phases.doc: Validates the selected resume snapshot and locks the owned lease for it.

files.doc: /** 🪪️ The journal preparation of the taxonomy plan apply. */

phases.name: prepareAttemptJournal
phases.doc: Loads the resumed journal or publishes the initial journal and lease of a new attempt.
